o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish براقمق (bıraqmaq) Proto-Turkic *bïrak- (“to let; to abandon; to send; to throw”). Cognate with Turkish bırakmak (“to abandon, release, relinquish”), Chuvash пӑрах (părah, “to throw; abandon; stop; let, set”), Gagauz brakmaa.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish صاحب (ṣāḥib), from Arabic صَاحِب (ṣāḥib).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اصیجاق (ıssıcaq), diminutive of اصی (ıssı). Compare Turkish and Gagauz sıcak.
Borrowed from Arabic مَلِكَة (malika). By surface analysis, məlik + -ə.
Borrowed from Russian чётки (čótki) or Russian счёты (‫‪sčóty).
